concerns.text: Task T006 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but creates a central logger module that writes to a shared `pipeline.log`. Concurrent execution could cause race conditions, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.
Task T098 extends the logger to record command‑line invocation, software versions, and seed. Like T006, this writes to the same log file and is not parallel‑safe, making the `[P]` tag incorrect.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – User Story 1 – Build & Export Co‑expression‑based PPI Predictions (US‑1): T065
concerns.text: Task T065 (batch‑effect correction) is scheduled before T014 (normalization). Batch‑effect correction should operate on already normalized expression values; the current order violates the data‑flow dependency.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – User Story 1 – Build & Export Co‑expression‑based PPI Predictions (US‑1): T014
concerns.text: Because T014 (normalization) follows T065, the pipeline would attempt batch correction on raw counts, contradicting FR‑014 which expects correction after normalization.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – User Story 2 – Quantitative Evaluation Against STRING (US‑2): US2 block
concerns.text: User Story 2 tasks (e.g., T021, T022, T023) depend on the edge list produced by US 1 (T018). This makes US 2 not independently shippable, violating the requirement that each US block be testable end‑to‑end on its own.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 4 – User Story 3 – Functional Enrichment of Predicted Interactome (US‑3): T108
concerns.text: Task T108 is described as a documentation update ‘renamed from duplicate T064’, but T064 is already used for the GEO downloader. The duplicate ID creates ambiguity and may lead to conflicting task execution.
